sentences.text: Shri Siddharth Datt, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri B.P. Pandey, G.A. for the respondent/State.
sh Heard on I.A.No.1435/2018, an application for taking additional document on record.
e ad On due consideration, the I.A. is allowed.
It appears Pr from the copy of order sheet dated 22/1/2018 of CJM, Damoh that applicant Dr. Deepak Jain surrendered before the trial a hy Court.
ad Heard on IA No.16/2018, for suspension of the sentence and grant of bail.

M of This criminal revision has been filed under Section 397/401 of Cr.P.C. against the judgment dated 20/12/2017 rt passed by Special Judge [Scheduled Castes and Scheduled ou Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act], Distt. Damoh in C Cri.Appeal No.1300140/2016, whereby learned Special Judge affirmed the judgment dated 1/8/2016 passed by CJM, Damoh h ig in Cr. Case No.700464/2009, whereby learned CJM found H applicant Dr. Deepak Jain guilty for the offence punishable under Sections 7 (ii) read with Section 16(i)(a)(ii) and 7 (iii) read with Section 16(i)(a)(ii)
of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo S.I. for one year with fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation respectively.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the trial Court as well as the appellate Court without appreciating the evidence wrongly convicted the applicant for the aforesaid offence.
Learned counsel further submitted that he was on bail during trial and the hearing of this revision will take long time.
Hence, prayed for suspension of sentence and release of the applicant on bail.
On the other hand learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer.
After hearing learned counsel for the applicant and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the sh application is allowed.

It is, therefore, directed that if e applicant deposits the entire fine amount and furnishes a ad personal bond in Pr the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs.Fifty Thousand only)
with a solvent surety in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the trial a hy Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 16/3/2018 and on such subsequent dates as may be fixed in ad this regard, the sentence of imprisonment awarded to him M shall remain suspended till further orders and he shall be released on bail.
